statements.name: thm:main
statements.text:
\label{thm:main}
The irrationality exponent of \(\pi\) is \(2\). More precisely, for every
real \(\nu>2\), there is an integer \(Q(\nu)\) such that
\[
\left|\pi-\frac pq\right|\ge q^{-\nu}
\qquad(p\in\ZZ,\ q\in\ZZ,\ q\ge Q(\nu)).
\]
